text: The dentist did a very gentle and clean teeth cleaning. However, when I asked them to check my retainer, they had made it extremely tight. I wasn't sure if that was okay or not, and I trusted the dentist, assuming there wouldn't be any problems otherwise. Two months later, it's still so tight it causes tooth pain and makes eating breakfast difficult, just like when I first had braces and my teeth were pulled. I called to ask if I could get it fixed, but the clinic said I would have to pay extra, even though they were the ones who made the retainer this way. It doesn't seem reasonable for a patient to have to pay extra for something that resulted from their own mistake.
